annotations.title: List Most Volatile AI Agent SDKs and MCP Servers

description: Read-only query that lists the fastest-changing or highest schema-drift-risk AI Agent SDKs and MCP servers from the live AgentBreakWatch telemetry index, sorted descending by 90-day release velocity. Supports filtering by kind ('sdk', 'mcp', 'all'), category hub slug, and result limit (1-50).

kind.description: Filter by Agent SDK ('sdk'), MCP server ('mcp'), or 'all'

limit.description: Maximum number of packages to return (default 15, max 50)

name: list_volatile_packages
